domain.d: The set of inputs a function accepts. The car's rule s(t) = t² is only meant for 0 ≤ t ≤ 10 seconds, so that stretch of time is its domain.

vertex.d: The turning point of a parabola: its lowest point if it opens upward, its highest if it opens downward. For y = c·x² it is the origin (0, 0).

vertical line test.d: A graph shows a function of x only if every vertical line crosses it at most once, because each input may have only one output. A circle fails: one vertical line can cross it twice.

Euler's number.d: The constant e ≈ 2.71828. It is the base for which the exponential eˣ has a slope equal to its own height everywhere, which makes it the natural base for growth and for logarithms.
